lesson.concept: When the question says 'solve in the interval [0; 360]', give the specific values inside that interval only. Do not give the general solution with +k.360. Save the +k.360 for the general-solution questions.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: Solve for x in [0; 360]: sin x = 0.5
work: Sine is positive in Q1 and Q2.

probe.problem: Solve for x in [0; 360]: cos x = 0.5.

learner_message: The question asked for x in an interval, so give the specific values only. Save the + k.360 form for questions that ask for a general solution.
